tha-ap454:1.1: Morahatthiya.] Morahatthaṃ gahetvāna upesiṃ lokanāyakaṃ / pasannacitto sumano morahattham adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap454:2.1: Iminā morahatthena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / nibbanti me tayo aggī labhāmi vipulaṃ sukhaṃ. // //
tha-ap454:3.1: Aho Buddhā aho dhammā aho no satthu sampadā / datvān' ahaṃ morahatthaṃ labhāmi vipulaṃ sukhaṃ. // //
tha-ap454:4.1: Tivaggī nibbutā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā / sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
tha-ap454:5.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi morahatthass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap454:9.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Morahatthiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
